title: How AI and digital technology is transforming fragrance creation and olfactory understanding
summary: At the 15th annual IFRA UK Fragrance Forum, experts discussed how olfaction is being digitalised, and pitted human against artificial intelligence in scent creation

extraction.key_fact: IFRA UK 프래그런스 포럼에서 전문가들이 후각의 디지털화를 논의하고 사람과 인공지능의 조향을 겨뤘다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: At the 15th annual IFRA UK Fragrance Forum, experts discussed how olfaction is being digitalised, and pitted human against artificial intelligence in scent creation
